speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing this persistent cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with exertion?

speaker: Patient
text: It's been about two weeks, and yes, the cough and breathlessness get much worse when I'm working hard or trying to sleep. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Ischemic Stroke with post-stroke respiratory complications (likely aspiration or atelectasis).
